answer_1.quote: We evaluate on the following two benchmarks: 1) Multilingual Dolly-200 Eval set measures a language model's open-ended generation ability. ... 2) FLORES-200 measures a language model's translation ability via spBLEU score.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to prompts for safety and general evaluation

answer_2.quote: FLORES-200 measures a language model's translation ability via spBLEU score.

answer_3.quote: We use the LLM-as-an-evaluator setup with GPT-4 to classify the model generations as harmful or not...

answer_4.quote: To ensure the validity of our use of LLMs as evaluators, we conduct compensated human evaluations specifically for safety.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classify whether the presented prompt and completion are harmful or not.
